headline: Frontier Ledger Shows Fresh Strategic Shifts
war_summary: The latest returns show the contested belt still unsettled, but with several changes since the previous edition. Nevish Line has recorded seven events in the last two hours and 46 across the day; its ledger now reads five Colonial and three Warden bases, replacing the earlier even split. Kuura Strand has become the freshest flashpoint, with ten events in two hours and 24 in the day, leaving five Warden bases and one strategic site neutral. Weathered Expanse has logged three recent events and 27 in 24 hours, now standing at seven Colonial and two Warden holdings. Callahan’s Passage remains a costly, heavily contested sector—29 daily base events and sharply rising enlistments—though no fresh event appears in the latest two-hour window. Palantine Berm’s 36 daily events have likewise gone quiet recently, with seven Warden bases reported. Stlican Shelf shows 15 daily events and accelerating casualties, while Mooring County remains intensely active by manpower and losses despite only five recorded base events. Most other regions report little or no recent strategic movement. No victor is recorded.
